description: The two numbers on a per-resolution AI bill (Intercom Fin, Zendesk AI, Sierra, Decagon): the effective price per billed resolution and, given total conversations, the billed-resolution share. The vendor's definition of resolved is echoed back verbatim as the vendor definition, not verified. Both numbers are the vendor's own count and come back labelled vendor-reported, not Verified. A pure function over your input: reads nothing, stores nothing, needs no key. It always ends with the next step: send one export (bill lines with ticket ids plus your ticket export for the same period) to check_vendor_bill, which recounts it.

bill_total.description: What the vendor billed for the period, in the bill currency.

billed_resolutions.description: How many resolutions the vendor billed in the period.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the bill, such as USD (the default) or EUR.

period.description: The billing period the bill covers (from on or before to).

from.description: Period start, a date such as 2026-10-01.

to.description: Period end, a date such as 2026-10-31.

total_conversations.description: All conversations the agent handled in the period; adds the billed-resolution share.

vendor.description: The vendor name, if you want it echoed.

vendor_resolved_definition.description: The vendor's own wording for what counts as resolved; echoed back verbatim as the vendor's definition, not verified.

name: metrx_cost_per_resolution
title: Cost Per Resolution
